nodes.name:
uv run python scripts/plan_mutmut_shards.py \
  --changed-files /tmp/changed_py.txt \
  --changed-diff /tmp/changed_py.diff \
  --shard-id "${{ matrix.shard }}" \
  --num-shards 16 \
  --max-children 2 \
  --output /tmp/mutmut-shard.txt
mapfile -t MUTANT_NAMES < /tmp/mutmut-shard.txt
if [ "${#MUTANT_NAMES[@]}" -eq 0 ]; then
  echo "No changed mutants assigned to manual mutation shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/16."
  echo "has_mutants=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
  exit 0
fi
echo "has_mutants=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
echo "Mutating manual shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/16: ${#MUTANT_NAMES[@]} exact mutants"
MUTMUT_EVIDENCE_DIR=mutants/mutmut-exact-evidence
mkdir -p "$MUTMUT_EVIDENCE_DIR"
MUTMUT_EVIDENCE_FINALIZED=false
MUTMUT_FAILURE_REASON="preparing exact mutation execution evidence"
mutmut_exit_code=""
tee_exit_code=""
# Once a shard has selected mutants, every non-success exit must leave
# an auditable partial result set and proof. This includes setup,
# deadline, budget, and exact-verification failures before mutmut runs.
finalize_incomplete_mutmut_evidence() {
  local failure_exit_code="$1"
  local exporter_args=(
    --selected-file /tmp/mutmut-shard.txt
    --finalize-incomplete-execution "$MUTMUT_EVIDENCE_DIR/execution-plan.json"
    --failure-exit-code "$failure_exit_code"
    --failure-reason "$MUTMUT_FAILURE_REASON"
  )
  if [ -n "$mutmut_exit_code" ]; then
    exporter_args+=(--mutation-exit-code "$mutmut_exit_code")
  fi
  if [ -n "$tee_exit_code" ]; then
    exporter_args+=(--tee-exit-code "$tee_exit_code")
  fi
  uv run python scripts/export_mutmut_shard_stats.py "${exporter_args[@]}" \
    --execution-proof "$MUTMUT_EVIDENCE_DIR/execution-proof.json" \
    --execution-evidence-dir "$MUTMUT_EVIDENCE_DIR" || return $?
  test -s "$MUTMUT_EVIDENCE_DIR/execution-proof.json" || return $?
  test -s "$MUTMUT_EVIDENCE_DIR/selected-mutants.json" || return $?
  test -s "$MUTMUT_EVIDENCE_DIR/selected-results.json" || return $?
}
on_mutation_step_exit() {
  local exit_code="$?"
  local finalizer_exit_code=0
  trap - EXIT
  if [ "$exit_code" -ne 0 ] && [ "$MUTMUT_EVIDENCE_FINALIZED" != "true" ]; then
    set +e
    finalize_incomplete_mutmut_evidence "$exit_code"
    finalizer_exit_code="$?"
    if [ "$finalizer_exit_code" -ne 0 ]; then
      echo "::error::Unable to finalize incomplete mutation evidence."
    fi
  fi
  exit "$exit_code"
}
trap on_mutation_step_exit EXIT
uv run python scripts/export_mutmut_shard_stats.py \
  --selected-file /tmp/mutmut-shard.txt \
  --prepare-exact-execution "$MUTMUT_EVIDENCE_DIR/execution-plan.json" \
  --execution-evidence-dir "$MUTMUT_EVIDENCE_DIR"
MUTMUT_FAILURE_REASON="deriving the stats-based mutation budget"
MUTMUT_BUDGET_TIMEOUT_SECONDS="$(uv run python scripts/mutmut_shard_budget.py \
  --selected-file /tmp/mutmut-shard.txt \
  --stats mutants/mutmut-stats.json \
  --max-children 2 \
  --max-timeout-seconds 18000 \
  --output "$MUTMUT_EVIDENCE_DIR/shard-budget.json")"
if ! [[ "$MUTMUT_BUDGET_TIMEOUT_SECONDS" =~ ^[1-9][0-9]*$ ]]; then
  MUTMUT_FAILURE_REASON="mutation budget helper returned an unsafe timeout value"
  echo "::error::Mutation budget helper returned an unsafe timeout value."
  exit 1
fi
# The 18,000-second budget is only an upper cap.  The timeout starts
# after setup, so derive a lower cap from the durable job deadline and
# leave 3,570 seconds after timeout's 30-second KILL grace for proof,
# score verification, upload, and a fail-closed exit.
if ! [[ "${MUTMUT_JOB_DEADLINE_EPOCH:-}" =~ ^[1-9][0-9]*$ ]]; then
  MUTMUT_FAILURE_REASON="mutation job deadline is missing or invalid"
  echo "::error::Mutation job deadline is missing or invalid; refusing to run without post-run evidence headroom."
  exit 1
fi
MUTMUT_FAILURE_REASON="deriving the deadline-bounded mutation timeout"
MUTMUT_POST_RUN_UPLOAD_RESERVE_SECONDS=3570
MUTMUT_TIMEOUT_KILL_GRACE_SECONDS=30
MUTMUT_CURRENT_EPOCH="$(date -u +%s)"
MUTMUT_REMAINING_JOB_SECONDS="$((MUTMUT_JOB_DEADLINE_EPOCH - MUTMUT_CURRENT_EPOCH))"
MUTMUT_REMAINING_TIMEOUT_SECONDS="$((MUTMUT_REMAINING_JOB_SECONDS - MUTMUT_POST_RUN_UPLOAD_RESERVE_SECONDS - MUTMUT_TIMEOUT_KILL_GRACE_SECONDS))"
if [ "$MUTMUT_REMAINING_TIMEOUT_SECONDS" -lt 1 ]; then
  MUTMUT_FAILURE_REASON="mutation deadline leaves no execution time after required evidence headroom"
  echo "::error::Mutation deadline leaves no execution time after the required 3570-second post-run/upload reserve and 30-second KILL grace."
  exit 1
fi
MUTMUT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS="$MUTMUT_BUDGET_TIMEOUT_SECONDS"
if [ "$MUTMUT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS" -gt "$MUTMUT_REMAINING_TIMEOUT_SECONDS" ]; then
  MUTMUT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS="$MUTMUT_REMAINING_TIMEOUT_SECONDS"
fi
if [ "$MUTMUT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS" -lt "$MUTMUT_BUDGET_TIMEOUT_SECONDS" ]; then
  MUTMUT_FAILURE_REASON="mutation deadline cannot satisfy the verified shard budget"
  echo "::error::Mutation deadline only permits ${MUTMUT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS}s but the verified shard budget requires ${MUTMUT_BUDGET_TIMEOUT_SECONDS}s; refusing to run incomplete mutation evidence."
  exit 1
fi
echo "Derived fail-closed manual mutation timeout: ${MUTMUT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS}s"
rm -f .mutmut-cache
MUTMUT_FAILURE_REASON="mutmut pipeline did not complete"
set +e
timeout --kill-after=30s "${MUTMUT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS}s" uv run python scripts/run_mutmut_with_stats.py --max-children 2 "${MUTANT_NAMES[@]}" 2>&1 | tee "$MUTMUT_EVIDENCE_DIR/mutmut-run.log"
pipeline_status=("${PIPESTATUS[@]}")
mutmut_exit_code="${pipeline_status[0]}"
tee_exit_code="${pipeline_status[1]}"
set -e
if [ "$tee_exit_code" -ne 0 ]; then
  MUTMUT_FAILURE_REASON="unable to persist mutmut output"
  echo "::error::Unable to persist mutmut output; exact mutation evidence is incomplete."
  exit "$tee_exit_code"
fi
mutants_started=0
if grep -qF 'Running mutation testing' "$MUTMUT_EVIDENCE_DIR/mutmut-run.log"; then mutants_started=1; fi
if [ "$mutmut_exit_code" -eq 0 ]; then
  MUTMUT_FAILURE_REASON="verifying exact mutmut execution"
  uv run python scripts/export_mutmut_shard_stats.py \
    --selected-file /tmp/mutmut-shard.txt \
    --verify-exact-execution "$MUTMUT_EVIDENCE_DIR/execution-plan.json" \
    --execution-proof "$MUTMUT_EVIDENCE_DIR/execution-proof.json" \
    --execution-evidence-dir "$MUTMUT_EVIDENCE_DIR" \
    --output mutants/mutmut-cicd-stats.json
  test -s mutants/mutmut-cicd-stats.json
  test -s "$MUTMUT_EVIDENCE_DIR/execution-proof.json"
  test -s "$MUTMUT_EVIDENCE_DIR/selected-mutants.json"
  test -s "$MUTMUT_EVIDENCE_DIR/selected-results.json"
  # Preserve the completed proof if the independent score gate fails.
  MUTMUT_EVIDENCE_FINALIZED=true
  echo "Verifying viable mutation score (manual evidence gate at 100%)..."
  uv run python scripts/mutmut_ci_gate.py
elif [ "$mutmut_exit_code" -eq 124 ]; then
  MUTMUT_FAILURE_REASON="mutmut exceeded its stats-derived timeout"
  echo "::error::Manual mutation testing exceeded its stats-derived budget; incomplete evidence is not valid."
  exit 124
elif [ "$mutants_started" -eq 1 ]; then
  MUTMUT_FAILURE_REASON="mutmut exited after the mutant phase began"
  echo "::error::mutmut exited $mutmut_exit_code after the mutant phase began; incomplete evidence is not valid."
  exit "$mutmut_exit_code"
else
  MUTMUT_FAILURE_REASON="mutmut exited before the mutant phase began"
  echo "::error::mutmut exited $mutmut_exit_code before the mutant phase began; failing the evidence run."
  exit "$mutmut_exit_code"
fi
